why: The test centre's own way in from Lordship Lane to its car park beside Woodall House: unnamed and 16 m long, so the route planner will not turn into it (a short unnamed road is a link or a stub to it) and the route could not come back into the centre. Named for the place it leads to, as the sign at its mouth would; every test leaves and returns by it.
The car park aisle beside the test centre at the end of its way in (see the fix above), 14 m: named the same so the way in and the aisle read as one road to the planner.
